name: tegen-wrf
what: Monthly aerosol optical depth at 550 nm per pascal for six aerosol types on 12 pressure levels (20-959 hPa), 46 latitudes (89S-89N) and 72 longitudes (180W-175E): the climatology WRF's RRTMG shortwave reads under aer_opt = 1.

arrays.aod_per_pa: float32 (species 6, month 12, lat 46, level 12, lon 72), WRF aerosol_in's read order (ks, m, j, k, i)

source.distribution: WRF v4.6.1, run/ directory (github.com/wrf-model/WRF tag v4.6.1); identical bytes in the WRF 4.7.1 build used to cut this file
source.conversion: each whitespace-separated token parsed to float32, reshaped in WRF aerosol_in's loop order, numpy savez_compressed; no value changed
source.origin: WRF module_physics_init.F aerosol_in: 'Data from Ryan Torn, computed from EC 6 types of aerosol data', the ECMWF regridding of Tegen et al. (1997)

licence.terms: public domain (WRF LICENSE.txt: NCAR and UCAR make no proprietary claims and consider WRF to be in the public domain for use by any person or entity for any purpose); UCAR's requested notice is in this distribution's NOTICE and licenses/LICENSE-WRF-public-domain.txt

references: Tegen, I., P. Hollrig, M. Chin, I. Fung, D. Jacob and J. Penner, 1997: Contribution of different aerosol species to the global aerosol extinction optical thickness: Estimates from model results. J. Geophys. Res., 102, 23895-23915.
WRF v4.6.1 phys/module_radiation_driver.F aer_time_int, aer_p_int; phys/module_physics_init.F aerosol_in, interp_vec; phys/module_ra_rrtmg_sw.F swaerpr and the iaer = 6 branch of rrtmg_sw

sanity_at_cut.method: sum over the 12 levels of value times a level thickness from midpoints with a 1013.25 hPa bottom, nearest grid point
